_about: The buildable boat (core/boat_rules.gd decides, game/boat.gd shows it; its parts and slipway: data/buildables.json). start = where it floats once built ([x, z] from that island's middle), bow pointing out to sea. Speeds in metres a second: max_speed ahead, reverse_speed astern; accel = how fast it picks up speed, brake = how fast the opposite throttle stops it, drag = how fast it slows with the keys let go (all m/s a second). turn_rate_deg = degrees a second at turn_full_at m/s or faster (slower = it turns less; standing still it does not turn). draught = the water it needs under it (metres): where the sea is shallower it runs aground and stops; it can always back off toward deeper water. half_length = bow and stern are checked this far from its middle. seats = where the people aboard are, [right, up, back] in metres from its middle at the waterline; seat 0 is the helm: whoever sits there steers with the move keys. Nobody aboard can shoot. board_reach = metres from its middle within which you can climb aboard; land_reach = how near dry sand it must lie for you to get off. bob = how it rocks (metres, degrees, seconds per wave).
name: Skiff
